question: Which of the following is the correct order of increasing wavelength?

options.text: microwaves, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma rays
gamma rays, ultraviolet, X-rays, visible, microwaves, infrared
gamma rays, X-rays, ultraviolet, visible, infrared, microwaves
X-rays, gamma rays, visible, ultraviolet, microwaves, infrared

solution: From shortest to longest: gamma rays < X-rays < ultraviolet < visible < infrared < microwaves < radio waves.
